boundary.decision_rule: Usa W06 cuando la base del taller ya está cerrada y el paso siguiente es producir una sola pieza citada, con una tesis y una audiencia; si lo que falta es un mapa de oportunidades priorizadas para aplicar esa base al trabajo, usa W07; si la pieza ya existe y hay que probarla bajo preguntas hostiles, usa W09. W06 no prioriza casos ni ensaya la defensa oral, y lo que entrega es borrador citado: RENDERED_DRAFT no es publicado.

persona.title: Cited piece from my base
persona.purpose: Turns the closed workshop base into a piece with one thesis, a citation per material claim and visible editorial calls, when you need something you can defend.
persona.when: you need a content piece and the workshop base is already audited and declared sufficient.
persona.example: A cited executive memo about what I learned, for my manager.
persona.evidence: final piece with thesis, tension and limit, sources cited per material claim, labelled inferences and three typed editorial decisions (left out, simplified, highlighted) with their reason.
persona.prompt: I want to turn my audited base into [CONTENT TYPE] of [LENGTH] for [AUDIENCE], aiming at [RESULT]. Only my Notebook: one thesis serving [RESULT], strongest evidence, one tension, one limit; propose structure; cite every material claim; label inferences; no external facts. If my base does not hold it, propose the thesis it holds and say what is missing. Do not rank use cases: one piece comes out. Deliver the final piece, its sources and three editorial decisions (left out, simplified, highlighted) with the reason, as a draft for the next step. Do not invent quotes or facts my base lacks.
